task: Review implemented RSP-16 Cap revival portability and private persona boundary.
user_intent: Norven wants Cap revival to work across machine migration, multi-user setups, and path changes while keeping Cap private identity material separate from the public RedCap workflow repository.
main_claim: This is an implementation review. Cap accepted the previous Prism concerns and implemented RSP-16 only for path portability and public evidence boundary verification. It does not migrate, copy, edit, commit, push, or expose private identity content.

prior_prism_concerns.concern: The original plan contradicted itself by saying RSP-16 must not read private identity body while also allowing real identity hash/count/title checks under the RSP-16 label.
prior_prism_concerns.cap_resolution: RSP-16 portability-check is fixture-only and reports real_private_identity_opened=false, copied=false, migrated=false. Normal soul-load may check the current configured source, but its public evidence now redacts real resolved paths and private title text.

prior_prism_concerns.concern: Co-locating portability_check inside soul_loader.py would create a leak boundary risk.
prior_prism_concerns.cap_resolution: Portability check lives in runtime/core/cap_revival_portability.py and is dispatched by runtime/bin/redcap soul-load portability-check. It invokes soul-load only through temporary fixture HOME and CAP_HOME values.

changed_reality: runtime/core/soul_loader.py now redacts private identity resolved_path to $CAP_HOME/identity.md or ~/.cap/identity.md and writes title_present instead of the private title text.
runtime/core/cap_revival_portability.py performs fixture-only positive and negative migration probes.
assets/contracts/cap-revival-portability.json defines allowed and forbidden public evidence fields.
runtime/bin/redcap routes soul-load portability-check to the new module.
assets/evidence/soul/latest-load.json and load-ledger.jsonl were regenerated with the redacted shape.
assets/evidence/rsp/rsp-16-cap-revival-portability.json records positive, negative, fixture leak scan, public text scan, and structured soul evidence scan results.
assets/evidence/rsp/rsp-16-claim.json and lifecycle packet scope the completion claim to RSP-16 only.
self-purification evidence records a no_promote decision without writing private persona body.
review_questions: Do the implementation and evidence resolve the prior concern that RSP-16 might read/hash/summarize real private identity content under the portability check?
Is the separation between soul_loader.py and cap_revival_portability.py sufficient to reduce leak boundary risk?
Does the generated public evidence avoid private body, secret fixture strings, real private identity absolute path, and real private title text?
Does this close only RSP-16 without overclaiming RedCap full revival or private identity migration?

file_access.purpose: Review RSP-16 public implementation and evidence only. Do not read private identity body.
forbidden_paths: any real private Cap identity file
